cc:Work.dc:description: The plotted curve is the complete coupled mixed-spin trajectory; this record's coefficient table describes one HS/LS reference endmember. The source-constrained diagnostic uses both Table 7 endmembers and the Table 2 midpoint. The refit's internal omega0, omitted from the ledger, is recovered algebraically from both stored endmembers and its stored 50% transition pressure. No optimizer is run. Vertical pressure RMS is descriptive; the original audit minimized approximate volume residuals plus priors, and exact MINUTI weights/workflow remain unknown.
